summary: Learn: Interface vs Type, extending interfaces
description: Object types can be defined with {}, type, or interface. interface supports extends to inherit from multiple parents (less boilerplate); intersection (&) combines types but conflicts collapse to never instead of erroring like extends does. Covers optional properties (?) and union types (|).

comments.author: Katie Nguyen
comments.text: [Code Review Feedback] Great job documenting your learning! Correctly identified that extends shows conflicts as errors while intersection can lead to never type. Good understanding of optional properties and union types. Tip: when you use interfaces in real code, remember to add the export keyword so other files can import them.

summary: Learn: async/await, Promises, fetch vs Axios
description: async functions return a Promise immediately; await pauses until it settles; try/catch handles rejections; fetch() needs .json() to parse the body; Axios auto-rejects non-2xx and auto-parses JSON.

comments.author: Katie Nguyen
comments.text: [Code Review Feedback] Solid explanation and comparison. Note: since we use fetch() (not Axios), it only throws on network errors, not 404/500 — fetchWordDefinition needs try/catch around the whole function body, not just the JSON parsing. Status: Approved.

summary: Learn: Firestore CRUD operations
description: setDoc() requires a doc ID and overwrites by default (merge:true to patch). Covers building a Firestore data converter (toFirestore/fromFirestore) so custom classes can be written/read directly. addDoc() auto-generates an ID and returns a DocumentReference. Clarifies that Firestore auto-generates the document ID but NOT createdAt/updatedAt timestamps — those must be set explicitly, which is why Omit<Word,'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'> is used as the input type.

comments.author: Katie Nguyen
comments.text: [Code Review Feedback - APPROVED] Covered all key Firestore CRUD ops: setDoc with converters, getDoc/getDocs with where(), addDoc, updateDoc (nested fields, arrayUnion, increment), deleteDoc/deleteField. Great job connecting the converter pattern to wordService.ts.

summary: Create wordService.ts with CRUD operations
description: Firestore does NOT auto-add timestamps (unlike e.g. Mongo's timestamps:true) — use serverTimestamp() explicitly on create and update. Bug fixes: id must come from snapshot.id, not data.id; toFirestore() needed to add createdAt/updatedAt; updateWord needed to set updatedAt; getDoc return type mismatch (DocumentSnapshot vs QueryDocumentSnapshot).

comments.author: Katie Nguyen
comments.text: [Code Review - Changes Needed] 4 issues: id should be snapshot.id not data.id; toFirestore missing timestamps; updateWord needs updatedAt; type mismatch on getDoc return. What went well: correct v9 imports, good converter pattern, all 5 CRUD ops, proper Omit<> usage.

comments.author: Katie Nguyen
